terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A tall square open steel lattice truss tower on a concrete footing, a hanging cluster of black concert line-array speakers near the top on one side and a bank of six stadium floodlights at the very top, magenta painted accent bands. Photoreal studio product photograph of a premium toy-grade scale model, glossy automotive clearcoat paint, real rubber, brushed and chromed metal, real fabric, fine surface detail and light wear, saturated street-art colours. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
